topic: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking

en.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking in October
en.dek: French officials blame Iranian hackers for disrupting refrigeration at hundreds of businesses last month
facts: French officials suspect Iranian hackers disrupted supermarket refrigeration in October according to The Jerusalem Post
The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up according to BBC
Politico Europe reported that 700 food distribution points were affected by the cyberattacks last month
French foreign minister summoned Iranian ambassador following the accusations according to New York Times
body: French officials have accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of carrying out a cyberattack targeting supermarket refrigeration systems in France last month, The Jerusalem Post reports.
The cyber-attack affected commercial refrigerators and freezers across France, with temperatures rising in affected units, BBC reports.
According to Dawn, French officials accused Iran of being behind refrigerator hacks that disrupted cooling systems at hundreds of businesses.
Politico Europe reported that 700 food distribution points were affected by the cyberattacks last month.
French cybersecurity agencies are investigating the scope of the disruption and its impact on food supply chains, according to multiple outlets.
The French foreign minister stated that he summoned the Iranian ambassador to France following a cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems last month, according to the New York Times.
Iran did not immediately respond to the accusation, while Sky News reported that France formally accused Iran of being behind the incident.
International observers are monitoring the situation as tensions rise between the two nations.
en.context: French and international media report that French officials have pointed the finger at Iranian hackers for a cyberattack targeting supermarket refrigeration systems in October. The attack caused cooling systems in hundreds of stores to malfunction, raising concerns about food safety and supply chain security. Media outlets including The Jerusalem Post, BBC, Dawn and Politico Europe have covered the developing situation.

de.dek: Französische Beamte machen iranische Hacker für die Störung der Kühlung in Hunderten von Geschäften im letzten Monat verantwortlich
body: Französische Beamte vermuten laut The Jerusalem Post, dass iranische Hacker im Oktober die Kühlsysteme in Hunderten von Geschäften gestört haben.
Laut BBC wurden letzten Monat Kühlschränke und Gefrierschränke in Hunderten von Supermärkten in Frankreich überhitzt.
Französische Behörden haben laut The Jerusalem Post die iranische Revolutionsgarden beschuldigt, den Cyberangriff auf Supermarkt-Kühlschränke durchgeführt zu haben.
Der Hack führte zu Fehlfunktionen der Kühlungssysteme in Supermärkten, wobei die Temperaturen in den betroffenen Einheiten stiegen, berichtet die BBC.
Der Vorfall ist der jüngste in einer Reihe von Cybervorfällen, die iranischen Akteuren zugeschrieben werden und westliche Infrastruktur ins Visier nehmen.
Französische Cybersicherheitsagenturen untersuchen den Umfang der Störung und deren Auswirkungen auf die Lebensmittelversorgungsketten.

en.headline: France weighs sanctions after blaming Iran for fridge cyberattacks
en.body: France stated that the cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps carried out a campaign that caused millions of euros in damage. According to Le Monde, the French government said the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ordered the mid-October attack against supermarkets and other facilities.

es.headline: Francia sopesa sanciones tras culpar a Irán de ciberataques contra frigoríficos
es.body: Francia afirmó que la unidad cibernética del Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica de Irán llevó a cabo una campaña que causó daños por valor de millones de euros. Según Le Monde, el Gobierno francés indicó que el Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica ordenó el ataque de mediados de octubre contra supermercados y otras instalaciones.

fr.headline: La France envisage des sanctions après avoir imputé à l'Iran des cyberattaques contre des réfrigérateurs
fr.body: La France a déclaré que l'unité cybernétique du Corps des gardiens de la révolution islamique d'Iran avait mené une campagne ayant causé des millions d'euros de dégâts. Selon Le Monde, le gouvernement français a indiqué que le Corps des gardiens de la révolution islamique avait ordonné l'attaque de la mi-octobre contre des supermarchés et d'autres installations.

de.headline: Frankreich erwägt Sanktionen nach Vorwürfen gegen Iran wegen Cyberangriffen auf Kühlschränke
de.body: Frankreich erklärte, dass die Cyber-Einheit der iranischen Revolutionsgarden eine Kampagne durchgeführt habe, die Schäden in Millionenhöhe verursachte. Dem Le Monde zufolge erklärte die französische Regierung, die Revolutionsgarden hätten den Angriff Mitte Oktober gegen Supermärkte und andere Einrichtungen angeordnet.

zh.headline: 法国在指责伊朗发动冰箱网络攻击后正权衡实施制裁
zh.body: 法国表示，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队的网络部队发动了一场造成数百万欧元损失的攻击行动。据《世界报》报道，法国政府称伊斯兰革命卫队下令对超市和其他设施实施了这起发生在10月中旬的攻击。

pt.headline: França pondera sanções após culpar o Irão por ciberataques a frigoríficos
pt.body: A França declarou que a unidade cibernética do Corpo da Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irão levou a cabo uma campanha que causou milhões de euros em danos. Segundo o Le Monde, o governo francês afirmou que o Corpo da Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica ordenou o ataque de meados de outubro contra supermercados e outras instalações.

it.headline: La Francia valuta sanzioni dopo aver accusato l'Iran dei cyberattacchi ai frigoriferi
it.body: La Francia ha dichiarato che l'unità cibernetica del Corpo delle Guardie della Rivoluzione Islamica dell'Iran ha condotto una campagna che ha provocato danni per milioni di euro. Secondo quanto riportato da Le Monde, il governo francese ha affermato che i pasdaran hanno ordinato l'attacco di metà ottobre contro i supermercati e altre strutture.

ja.headline: フランス、冷蔵庫へのサイバー攻撃の責任をイランに帰し制裁を検討
ja.body: フランスは、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊のサイバー部隊が数百万ユーロの損害をもたらすキャンペーンを実行したと述べた。ル・モンド紙によると、フランス政府はイスラム革命防衛隊が10月中旬のスーパーマーケットやその他の施設に対する攻撃を命じたと述べた。

ko.headline: 프랑스, 냉장고 사이버 공격의 책임으로 이란 비난 후 제재 검토
ko.body: 프랑스는 이란 이슬람 혁명수비대의 사이버 부대가 수백만 유로의 피해를 야기한 캠페인을 수행했다고 밝혔다. 르 몽드에 따르면 프랑스 정부는 이슬람 혁명수비대가 10월 중순 슈퍼마켓 및 기타 시설에 대한 공격을 지시했다고 밝혔다.

en.headline: Canada reimposes sanctions on 11 Iranian entities
en.body: Canada reimposed sanctions on Iran for violating nuclear non-proliferation commitments. According to Reuters, the sanctions target 11 Iranian entities for contributing to nuclear activities.

es.headline: Canadá vuelve a imponer sanciones a 11 entidades iraníes
es.body: Canadá reimpuso sanciones a Irán por incumplir los compromisos de no proliferación nuclear. Según Reuters, las sanciones van dirigidas contra 11 entidades iraníes por contribuir a actividades nucleares.

fr.headline: Le Canada rétablit des sanctions contre 11 entités iraniennes
fr.body: Le Canada a rétabli des sanctions contre l'Iran pour violation de ses engagements en matière de non-prolifération nucléaire. Selon Reuters, ces sanctions ciblent 11 entités iraniennes pour leur contribution à des activités nucléaires.

de.headline: Kanada verhängt erneut Sanktionen gegen elf iranische Institutionen
de.body: Kanada hat wegen Verstößen gegen Verpflichtungen zur nuklearen Nichtverbreitung erneut Sanktionen gegen den Iran verhängt. Berichten von Reuters zufolge richten sich die Sanktionen gegen elf iranische Institutionen, die zu nuklearen Aktivitäten beigetragen haben.

zh.headline: 加拿大对11个伊朗实体重新施加制裁
zh.body: 加拿大因伊朗违反核不扩散承诺而对其重新施加制裁。据路透社报道，该制裁针对11个参与核活动的伊朗实体。

pt.headline: Canadá reimpõe sanções a 11 entidades iranianas
pt.body: O Canadá reimpos sanções ao Irão por violação dos compromissos de não-proliferação nuclear. De acordo com a Reuters, as sanções visam 11 entidades iranianas por contribuírem para atividades nucleares.

it.headline: Il Canada reintroduce sanzioni contro 11 entità iraniane
it.body: Il Canada ha reintrodotto sanzioni contro l'Iran per aver violato gli impegni sulla non proliferazione nucleare. Secondo quanto riferito da Reuters, le sanzioni colpiscono 11 entità iraniane ritenute responsabili di aver contribuito ad attività nucleari.

ja.headline: カナダ、イランの11の組織に制裁を再発動
ja.body: カナダは、核不拡散のコミットメントに違反したとしてイランへの制裁を再発動した。ロイターによると、この制裁は核活動への貢献をしたイランの11の組織を対象としている。

ko.headline: 캐나다, 이란 11개 단체에 제재 재부과
ko.body: 캐나다는 핵 비확산 약속 위반에 대해 이란에 제재를 재부과했다. 로이터 통신에 따르면 이번 제재는 핵 활동에 기여한 이란의 11개 단체를 겨냥하고 있다.

ko.headline: 프랑스 관리들, 이란의 프랑스 슈퍼마켓 사이버 공격 비난

pt.body: Funcionários franceses acusaram os Guardas Revolucionários do Irão de serem responsáveis pelos ciberataques que afetaram frigoríficos comerciais e congeladores em toda a França no mês passado, segundo a Dawn. O Politico Europe relatou que 700 pontos de distribuição de alimentos foram afetados, segundo o Politico Europe.
pt.headline: Funcionários franceses acusam o Irão de ciberataques a supermercados franceses

zh.body: 据Dawn报道，法国官员指控伊朗革命卫队对上个月影响法国各地商业冰箱和冷柜的网络攻击负有责任。Politico Europe报道称，共有700个食品配送点受到影响。
zh.headline: 法国官员指控伊朗对法国超市发动网络攻击

sources.title: French officials accuse Iran of being behind refrigerator hacks
La France accuse l’Iran d’être à l’origine des cyberattaques visant les supermarchés

de.body: Französische Beamte vermuten, iranische Hacker störten im Oktober die Kühlsysteme in Hunderten von Unternehmen, wie The Jerusalem Post berichtet. Laut BBC wurden im letzten Monat Kühlschränke und Gefrierschränke in Hunderten von Supermärkten in Frankreich überhitzt.
de.headline: Französische Beamte vermuten, iranische Hacker störten Supermarkt-Kühlsysteme im Oktober

en.body: French officials suspect Iranian hackers disrupted refrigeration systems at hundreds of businesses in October according to The Jerusalem Post. The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up according to BBC.
en.headline: French officials suspect Iranian hackers disrupted supermarket refrigeration in October

es.body: Funcionarios franceses sospechan que hackers iraníes interrumpieron los sistemas de refrigeración en cientos de negocios en octubre, según The Jerusalem Post. El ciberataque del mes pasado provocó que neveras y congeladores en cientos de supermercados de toda Francia se calentaran, según la BBC.
es.headline: Funcionarios franceses sospechan que hackers iraníes interrumpieron la refrigeración de supermercados en octubre

fr.body: Des responsables français soupçonnent des hackers iraniens d'avoir perturbé les systèmes de réfrigération dans des centaines d'entreprises en octobre, selon The Jerusalem Post. La cyberattaque du mois dernier a provoqué le réchauffement des réfrigérateurs et congélateurs dans des centaines de supermarchés à travers la France, selon la BBC.
fr.headline: Des responsables français soupçonnent des hackers iraniens d'avoir perturbé la réfrigération des supermarchés en octobre

it.body: Funzionari francesi sospettano che hacker iraniani abbiano interrotto i sistemi di refrigerazione in centinaia di attività commerciali a ottobre, secondo The Jerusalem Post. L'attacco informatico dello scorso mese ha causato il surriscaldamento di frigoriferi e congelatori in centinaia di supermercati in Francia, secondo la BBC.
it.headline: Funzionari francesi sospettano hacker iraniani abbiano interrotto la refrigerazione nei supermercati a ottobre

ja.body: エルサレム・ポスト紙によると、フランス当局は10月にイランのハッカーが数百の事業所の冷蔵システムを妨害したと疑っている。BBCによると、先月のサイバー攻撃により、フランスの数百のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵庫や冷凍庫が温められた。
ja.headline: フランス当局、10月にイランのハッカーがスーパーの冷蔵設備を妨害したと疑う

ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트에 따르면 프랑스 관계자들은 이란 해커들이 10월 수백 개 사업장의 냉장 시스템을 방해했다고 의심하고 있다. BBC에 따르면 지난달 사이버 공격으로 프랑스 전역의 수백 개 슈퍼마켓의 냉장고와 냉동고가 가열되는 피해가 발생했다.
ko.headline: 프랑스 관계자들, 이란 해커들이 10월 슈퍼마켓 냉장 시설 방해 의심

pt.body: Funcionários franceses suspeitam que hackers iranianos perturbaram os sistemas de refrigeração em centenas de estabelecimentos em outubro, segundo The Jerusalem Post. O ciberataque do mês passado fez com que frigoríficos e congeladores em centenas de supermercados por França aquecessem, de acordo com a BBC.
pt.headline: Funcionários franceses suspeitam que hackers iranianos perturbaram a refrigeração de supermercados em outubro

zh.body: 据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，法国官员怀疑伊朗黑客在10月破坏了数百家企业的制冷系统。据BBC报道，上个月的这次网络攻击导致法国数百家超市的冰箱和冷冻室升温。
zh.headline: 法国官员怀疑伊朗黑客在10月破坏超市制冷系统

sources.title: France accuses Iran's Revolutionary Guards of cyberattack on supermarket fridges
France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
